newsitem.title: USA: Aksys says gets U.S. patent on method.
newsitem.headline: Aksys says gets U.S. patent on method.

text.p: Aksys Ltd said it got a U.S. patent for a hot water disinfection method for dialysis machines.
"The issued patent is the first in what the company expects to be a series of patents," Aksys said.

Aksys president Rod Kenley, lead inventor on the patent, said, "Hot water disinfection is an especially desirable feature of the machine and is a better alternative to the use of chemicals for disinfection."
Aksys is developing hemodialysis products and services for patients suffering from kidney failure, it said.
